# bintables/var

> Variable read: loads the variable's stack slot into rax.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/var.pkg)

`{addr}` is `qword [rbp-…]` for locals and `qword [rbp+…]` for
parameters (see the truck's conventions).

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
mov rax, {addr}
```
